description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing organization entities, including actions for creating, viewing, updating, deleting, and leaving organizations. It handles HTTP requests, interacts with models, and manages access control.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Organization
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing organization-related actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new organization, validating input and checking name availability.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures organization by name from URL, setting it in stash or detaching to error if not found.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays organization details, including users and projects, with access control for viewing.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization description and display name based on POST parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the organization and redirects based on user capabilities.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Allows a user to leave an organization.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the organization show page.
